svg.aria-label: At the top, in a chain each value starts only after the one before it, so the values light up one at a time. At the bottom, in PFOR thread t of a wave already knows its offset, bit t × 3, from 0 up to 93, and all 32 threads start at the same instant.
svg.text: 1 in a chain, value i starts only after value i - 1
2 in pfor, thread t already knows its offset, bit t × 3
3 all 32 threads of the wave start at the same instant
a chain moves one value at a time; a wave starts all 32 threads at once

g.text: each thread then decodes 8 values, slot t of lanes 0 to 7, b = 3, two-byte values
